All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Bishop
Represents a Bishop piece in the chess game.
BoardFactory
Factory class responsible for creating and initializing ChessBoard objects.
ChessBoard
Represents a full chess game state and board.
ChessgameWindow
The main Graphical User Interface (GUI) window for the chess game.
GameSaveFileManager
Utility class responsible for persisting and retrieving the state of a chess game to and from the local file system.
InvalidFENexception
Exception thrown when a Forsyth-Edwards Notation (FEN) string is invalid, malformed, or cannot be successfully parsed to create a board state.
King
Represents a King piece in the chess game.
Knight
Represents a Knight piece in the chess game.
LoadingException
Exception thrown to indicate that an error occurred while attempting to load data from the file system (e.g., reading a saved game or user settings).
Main
The main entry point for the Java Chess Engine application.
MenuWindow
Represents the main menu window of the chess application.
Move
Represents a single chess move.
MoveNotationException
Exception thrown when a chess move notation is invalid, cannot be parsed, or represents an illegal move on the board.
Pawn
Represents a Pawn piece in the chess game.
Piece
Abstract base class representing a generic chess piece.
Queen
Represents a Queen piece in the chess game.
Rook
Represents a Rook piece in the chess game.
SavingException
Exception thrown to indicate that an error occurred while attempting to save data to the file system (e.g., writing a game state or user settings).
Settings
Represents the configuration settings for the chess game.
SettingsFileManager
Utility class responsible for saving and loading the user's game settings to and from the local file system.
SettingsWindow
The Graphical User Interface (GUI) window for configuring game preferences.
